description: This file defines the EmailDao class, which provides data access methods for Email and EmailTemplate entities within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods to retrieve email details by name and to fetch email templates based on various criteria such as email name, locale, and roles.

classes.name: EmailDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for Email and EmailTemplate entities, encapsulating database query logic related to email configurations and templates.

methods.name: getEmailByName
methods.description: Retrieves an Email entity by its name.

methods.name: getEmailTemplateMatches
methods.description: Fetches email templates matching specified criteria such as email name, locale, recipient role, and performer role, with support for null role values.
